title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
summary: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang is ranked No. 1 on Glassdoor’s Best CEOs list for 2026. In the just-released ranking, recognition is earned directly from the people who know their leadership the best — employees.
